This is a large .NET project. To make it AOT-compatible, I need to understand what AOT compatibility issues exist. Let me look at common AOT issues in .NET:

2. Reflection-based serialization patterns

4. Missing trimming annotations

- `<EnableTrimAnalyzer>true</EnableTrimAnalyzer>`
- `<EnableAotAnalyzer>true</EnableAotAnalyzer>`
